sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS male_inpatient, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS male_outpatient, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN ID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN ID END), 0), 2) AS percentage FROM Patient
